info.title: RSI Public Platform API
info.description: Practice-scoped scheduling API for OAuth client-credentials integrations: patient match/create, slot discovery, and appointment booking/cancel. Grants with confirmation_required (llm_agent clients) perform every mutation in two phases — a 428 challenge, then an identical resend with the confirmationToken. Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json with a stable machine `code`. Currently supported practice-management systems: Nextech Select and Modernizing Medicine.

get.summary: List a patient's appointments.
get.description: Lists one patient's appointments — patientId is required; there is no cross-patient listing. With no date filters the window defaults to upcoming appointments. status is a response field, not a filter. Use this to find the appointment to cancel or confirm, then read it back before acting.

post.summary: Book a slot for a patient (two-phase 428 confirmation for confirmation-required clients).
post.description: Books a slot for a patient. Two-phase for confirmation-required clients: the first call returns 428 with a confirmationToken and a readBack — verify the readBack matches your intent, then resend the byte-identical body plus the token; 201 returns the appointmentId. Resending the same confirmed body+token replays the stored result — it never double-books, so an unsure network retry is safe. 409 slot_unavailable means the slot was taken since the search or no longer passes the practice's online-scheduling rules: re-run searchSlots and offer new times. There is no free-text visit reason — the slot already encodes the visit type and procedure.

get.summary: Read a single appointment.
get.description: Reads one appointment with resolved display names (provider, location, visit type, procedure) — the read-back before a cancel, and the state-verification read after a 409 confirmation_incomplete or a 500 on a write. An id from another practice or an unknown id is an indistinguishable 404.

parameters.description: Opaque apt_… id from searchAppointments or bookAppointment.

post.summary: Cancel an appointment (two-phase 428 confirmation for confirmation-required clients).
post.description: Cancels an appointment — find it via searchAppointments first and read it back before acting. Two-phase for confirmation-required clients: the first call (body optional) returns 428 with a confirmationToken; resend with { confirmationToken } as the body to execute. 200 returns status "cancelled".

parameters.description: Opaque apt_… id of the appointment to cancel, from searchAppointments.

post.description: Records that the patient will attend. Two-phase for confirmation-required clients: the first call (body optional) returns 428 with a confirmationToken; resend with { confirmationToken } as the body to execute. 200 returns status "confirmed".

get.summary: Echo the scopes granted to the access token.
get.description: Echoes the scopes the presented token grants. Any valid token may call it — use it after obtaining a token to prove connectivity, and before promising an action to check the needed scope (e.g. appointments:cancel) is actually granted; if it isn't, offer a human handoff instead.

post.summary: Create a patient record in the practice's scheduling system.
post.description: Creates the patient in the practice's scheduling system; the returned patientId is usable immediately (e.g. to book). Two-phase for confirmation-required clients: the first call returns 428 with a confirmationToken and a readBack of the parsed fields — resend the identical body plus the token to execute. address is optional, except address.zip which Nextech Select practices require.

post.summary: Find exactly one patient by demographic match (first name, last name, phone, date of birth).
post.description: The identity gate: resolves the four demographic fields to exactly ONE patient — never a list; duplicate records resolve to one canonical patient. 404 means nobody matches (the patient may be new — offer to create a record). Call this before disclosing or changing anything for a patient, and use the returned id as patientId on every other call.

get.description: Reads one patient's full demographic record — the individual phone fields and full address the summary omits. Absent fields were simply not provided. An id from another practice or an unknown id is an indistinguishable 404.

put.summary: Update a patient record in the practice's scheduling system.
put.description: Replaces the patient's demographic core: send ALL of firstName, lastName, phone, and email even when changing only one — some scheduling systems do a full replace and would blank omitted fields, so a thin body is rejected with 422. Two-phase for confirmation-required clients: the first call returns 428; resend identically with the confirmationToken.

get.summary: Read the practice's profile and directory: contact details, locations and hours, providers, visit types and procedures, staff directory, policies, insurances, hospital affiliations.
get.description: Reads the profile of the practice the token belongs to — its name, callback phone, time zone (only when unambiguous across its listed locations), cancellation notice, financing and paperwork guidance, the locations shown for online scheduling with address, opening hours and contact points, staff directory, consultation policies, accepted insurance carriers with their plans, and hospital affiliations. Use it to answer the patient's questions about the practice itself ("where are you", "when are you open", "do you take my insurance", "what is your cancellation policy"). It also carries the directory with ids — the locations, the providers with the locations each practices at, and the visit types with the procedures the practice pairs with each for online scheduling — the same items the list endpoints return. None of it is filtered by the online-booking rules: for what the practice offers for online booking, use listSchedulingVisitTypes, listSchedulingLocations and listSchedulingProviders, and searchSlots for open times. Staff-authored text is plain text; empty lists mean the practice maintains nothing there.

get.summary: List the visit types and procedures offered for online booking.
get.description: The visit types, each with its procedures, offered for online booking — the same setup rules as online scheduling (enabled visit type + procedure shown in scheduling, provider assigned to it, active and shown, working at the location with business hours there). Start here: match the patient's concern against the procedure names and use the visit type the procedure is listed under; patientType says whether the practice books a procedure for new or existing patients. Narrow to a location or provider the patient already named. Next, listSchedulingProviders with the pair: who takes the visit, where, and on what terms. Does not check open times: searchSlots may return an empty page — try the next window, another location or provider. Unpaged short list.

With visitTypeId + procedureId: the providers who take that visit, each with the locations where it is offered with them and the terms that apply to them (charge, insurance, patient age range). Add locationId when the patient named a location. Does not check open times: searchSlots may return an empty page — try the next window, another location or provider. Unpaged short list.

get.summary: Search bookable slots for a visit type and procedure at a location within a date window.
get.description: Finds bookable times by the same rules as online scheduling. Pass the visit type + procedure pair from listSchedulingVisitTypes and a location where it is offered (each provider from listSchedulingProviders with the pair lists them), plus a from/to window of at most 14 days; add providerId for one provider, or omit it for every provider who takes the pair there. The scheduling lists do not check open times, so a valid query may return an empty page — the pair isn't offered at that location or nothing is open in that window: try the next window, another location or provider; for a longer horizon, run consecutive windows. Each slot names its provider, location, visit type and procedure, and its id is what you pass to getSlot and bookAppointment.

get.summary: Read a single slot with live availability and the details to read back before booking.
get.description: The pre-booking read-back: one slot with display names and live availability — available is true only when the slot still passes the rules searchSlots applies (the same rules as online scheduling), and such a slot is re-checked in the practice's scheduling system inside this read, so expect seconds rather than milliseconds. When available is false the response carries only id/start/end — re-search instead of reading it back. visitType/procedure may be absent when the practice's mapping can't pin a single answer; you already know the pair you searched with, so read those back.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code — branch on this, never on title/detail. One of: unauthorized, forbidden_scope, forbidden_tenant, not_found, validation, confirmation_required, confirmation_mismatch, confirmation_incomplete, slot_unavailable, conflict, rate_limited, quota_exceeded, capability_not_supported, upstream_unavailable, internal.

requestId.description: Correlation id to quote on escalation; the same value is echoed in the X-RSI-TRACE-ID response header. Absent on gateway-emitted errors (rate_limited, quota_exceeded).

requireInsurance.description: Whether booking this procedure requires insurance information — if true, expect the practice to collect it.

id.description: Opaque prc_… id for slot search and procedure reads.

name.description: Patient-facing display name — the one name used for this procedure everywhere on the API.

maximumAge.description: Oldest patient age this provider sees for the visit; absent when there is no maximum, or when visitTypeId and procedureId were not both given.

available.description: Live availability: true only when the slot still passes the rules slot search applies; such a slot is re-checked in the practice's scheduling system. When false, only id/start/end are returned — re-search instead of reading the slot back.

providerName.description: Provider display name to read back to the patient.

locationId.description: Opaque loc_… id of the slot's location.

locationName.description: Location display name to read back to the patient.

locationAddress.description: Location's full postal address, one line.

visitTypeId.description: Opaque vst_… id; absent together with visitType when the mapping can't pin one answer.

visitType.description: Visit type display name. May be absent when the practice's mapping can't pin one answer — read back the visit type you searched with.

procedureId.description: Opaque prc_… id; absent together with procedure when the mapping can't pin one answer.

procedure.description: Procedure display name — the same name listProcedures shows. May be absent when the mapping can't pin one answer — read back the procedure you searched with.

firstName.description: Patient's legal first name. The full demographic core is required even for a small change — omitted fields would be blanked.

confirmationToken.description: Omit on the first call; echo the token from the 428 challenge to execute. Changing any other field between the two calls is rejected with 409 confirmation_mismatch.
